title: Pan-Seared {p} with {v}
steps: Start the sides first, since they take the longest. {starch_how} {veg_how}
Bring the {p} out of the fridge 15 minutes ahead. Pat very dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
Sear the {p} in a hot oiled skillet, skin side down if it has skin, 6 to 8 minutes undisturbed until deeply golden.
Flip, then add the {sauce}, the {spice} and a splash of water. Spoon the pan juices over the {p} for 4 to 5 minutes, until {doneness}. Rest 5 minutes.
Slice and serve with the {v} and {s}.
tip: Skip the skin and use a smaller spoonful of butter. The pan juices still carry plenty of flavor.
